backend/main.mo: Main backend actor handling user profiles, contact inquiries, and fire extinguisher certificates with access control and CRUD-style query/update methods.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades old actor state by adding empty certificate and token maps while preserving inquiries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs for verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme configuration defining color tokens and dark mode variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all public and admin routes including certificate verification and editor pages.
Protects admin routes by requiring Internet Identity login and admin verification.
frontend/src/components/admin/DownloadCe: Button that generates and downloads a certificate PDF with loading state handling.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Simple component rendering the company logo with optional sizing.
frontend/src/components/CertificateDetai: UI component that renders full certificate details, validity status, and optional QR code.
frontend/src/components/CtaBar.tsx: CTA bar component rendering compact or full variants with call, email, and quote buttons.
frontend/src/components/QrCode.tsx: Canvas-based QR code renderer that draws a generated QR image using a utility function.
frontend/src/components/ServiceIcon.tsx: Displays one icon from a 3x3 sprite sheet by positioning a scaled image segment.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, navigation links, services list, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive site header with logo, navigation, admin link handling, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper adding header, footer, and routed page content.
frontend/src/content/routes.ts: Defines public and admin navigation link metadata for the site.
frontend/src/content/seoMeta.ts: SEO title and description metadata for all main site pages.
frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts: Structured site content including hero text, about info, services, and product details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, recreating it on identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCertificates.ts: Provides certificate-related queries and mutations using the actor, including fetch, create, update, and admin checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context and provider, handling login, identity loading, and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Updates the document title and meta description when provided values change.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Implements queries and mutations for contact inquiries using the actor and react-query.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom industrial-themed light/dark mode CSS variables and components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with company overview, values, and reasons to choose the service.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCertificat: Provides a form to create or edit fire extinguisher certificates, loading existing data when editing.
Displays a sortable list of all certificates with status indicators and links to view or edit.
frontend/src/pages/CertificateVerificati: Displays certificate details by token, handling loading, errors, and missing certificates.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and displays company contact info. Handles form state, errors, and calls a mutation on submit.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, trust indicators, service previews, and CTA components using site content data.
frontend/src/pages/IndustriesPage.tsx: Displays industries served with icons and descriptions plus detailed industry-specific fire safety solutions. Uses site content and structured card layouts.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Shows categorized fire safety products including extinguishers and expandable product sections. Uses cards and accordions populated from site content.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Lists completed fire safety projects with icons and descriptions and outlines project capabilities in structured cards.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Renders the public services page with service cards, process steps, and SEO metadata.
frontend/src/utils/certificates.ts: Utility functions for formatting dates, checking expiration, and parsing date strings.
frontend/src/utils/origin.ts: Returns the current origin and builds verification URLs for certificates.
frontend/src/utils/pdf/certificatePdf.ts: Generates a styled PDF certificate using canvas, including logo, fields, and QR code support.
frontend/src/utils/qr.ts: Creates a minimal QR code matrix and renders it to a PNG data URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helper utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH color palette, extended utilities, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing ICP dapp architecture, planned certificate/QR system, existing features, assets, and known deployment issues.
